en: Multiview color postcard with an orange border, featuring four oval photographs of buildings and historic structures from the city of Pécs. The upper two images show modern mid‑20th‑century multi‑story buildings, likely a hotel or commercial center and another institutional building. The lower left image shows a round medieval stone tower and fortification wall. The lower right image shows an Ottoman‑style mosque with a dome and minaret behind a stone wall, flanked by historic buildings. In the center is a white label with the word "PÉCS". The reverse side is a standard divided-back postcard layout with lines for address and space for a message, printed multilingual greetings from Pécs, publisher information from Budapest, price in forints, and boxes for postage stamps.
